trailhead.label: The Hotel Cendevaves on Monte Pana above Santa Cristina, the board’s start

cautions: Cars around the Monte Pana car parks at the start: keep your dog close.
Open meadows that are mown for hay in summer: keep your dog on the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The Hotel Cendevaves on Monte Pana above: L'Hotel Cendevaves sul Monte Pana sopra Santa Cristina, la partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.Cars around the Monte Pana car parks at: Auto attorno ai parcheggi del Monte Pana alla partenza: tieni il cane vicino.
textIt.Open meadows that are mown for hay in su: Prati aperti che d'estate vengono falciati per il fieno: tieni il cane sul sentiero.
